resources.string:
The AI assistant (working with Claude Code on your computer) asks to control the app “%1$s”.

It will see the screen of this app only, tap, scroll and type text. You enter passwords, payments and confirmations yourself.

To stop: the red “STOP” button at the top of the screen, “Stop” in the notification or the “Stop AI” tile.
The AI wants to perform an action (%1$s) that may open “%2$s”.\n\nThis target is on your block list. Allow only if you asked for it yourself.
